description: This file defines a React component 'ViewportControl' for managing and displaying geographic viewport parameters such as longitude, latitude, zoom, bearing, and pitch. It includes default values, rendering logic, and interaction handlers.

classes.name: ViewportControl
classes.description: A React component for controlling geographic viewport parameters with UI elements and popover display.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles updates to individual viewport parameters and triggers the onChange callback.

methods.name: renderTextControl
methods.description: Renders a labeled input control for a specific viewport parameter.

methods.name: renderPopover
methods.description: Renders the popover content containing all parameter controls.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Generates a label displaying the current longitude and latitude in sexagesimal format or 'N/A'.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main component UI including header, label, and popover trigger.
